summary: Iridium Communications Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary Iridium Monitor Holdings LLC entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement to acquire the remaining 61% of Aireon Holdings LLC from NAV CANADA and other air navigation service providers for aggregate consideration of approximately $366.7 million. The purchase price will be paid in two installments: 50% cash at closing and 50% deferred as a seller loan due one year later. Iridium currently owns 39% of Aireon and will own 100% post-closing. Closing is subject to HSR antitrust clearance and other customary conditions. The acquisition enhances Iridium's space-based ADS-B air traffic surveillance platform.
